findings.title: Context menu keyboard focus lifecycle is incomplete
findings.confidence: High-confidence static control-flow finding; macOS runtime reproduction NOT_RUN by reviewer.
findings.evidence: show_context_menu does not focus Menu. Menu::set_items only resets selection. Menu keyboard bindings are scoped to Menu, while Dismiss only intercepts mouse input. The six menu tests never assert focus or keyboard dispatch.
findings.impact: Esc/arrows/Enter may remain with the terminal; Enter may submit pending terminal input instead of activating the menu item.
findings.required_resolution: See docs/DESIGN.md section 6.2. Original GUI-shell/H1 batch is not reopened; the new menu extension is not accepted.
